arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users_with_online_transaction FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who made at least one online transaction, across all transactions in the data.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, covering the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
A user is counted once however many online transactions they made, and transactions are linked to users through their cards.
